title: Long searches in the background
text: Large searches (thousands sequences core_nt) can take hours. background = TRUE, parallel_blast() starts search separate process returns job , R session stays free. job keeps batches results directory (job_dir; default new directory BLASTr cache), goes even R session ends, can opened another session. get results, blast_job_result() waits end (progress bar interactive sessions) returns table parallel_blast(); wait = FALSE returns NULL job finished. blast_job_cancel() stops job. process running stopped (example, machine restarted), blast_job_status() reports job stopped blast_job_resume() restarts : batches already finished kept others searched .
